name: PowerBat360
notes:
First public preview. Interface in French.

- Dashboard with a battery score out of 100, live power draw and estimated time left.
- Time-left estimate per running app, with a "what if I close…" simulator.
- Optimize page: 17 checks (power mode, screen, sleep, startup apps…) you can fix in one click and undo.
- Battery page: health, wear and capacity history from Windows battery reports.
- History: a day-by-day usage journal with the apps that used the most energy.
- Automation: plugged/unplugged rules (60 Hz, brightness, power-hungry app alerts), low battery alert and an "unplug me" reminder.
- Charge limit detection for Lenovo ThinkPad, with guidance for other brands.
- Works on desktops without a battery too.
- Works offline: no account, no analytics, no network requests. Data stays on your PC.
